title: BGP Peer Flap on MPLS PE-CE Uplink
triage_steps: 1. Check physical link status and optic light levels (DOM / transceiver optical rx/tx power).
2. Query PE VRF routing table for BGP session state transitions: 'show bgp vpnv4 unicast summary'.
3. Inspect interface buffer discards and interface input drops on CE uplink.
4. Verify whether SD-WAN Dynamic Multipoint IPSec overlay auto-rerouted to secondary PE uplink.
remediation_actions: Trigger SD-WAN policy SLA override to favor alternative underlay path.
Engage SP Tier-3 NOC with Circuit ID reference.
Soft-clear BGP neighbor session with route-refresh if stuck in OpenSent.
blast_radius_impact: High if primary DC link; Medium if redundant CE is active.

title: IPSec Tunnel Jitter and SLA Breach on SD-WAN Overlay
triage_steps: 1. Verify IPFIX top-talker flows on the degraded IPSec tunnel.
2. Inspect underlay carrier latency along path: CE -> PE -> P -> PE -> CE.
3. Inspect Crypto IPsec SA stats for crypto packet drops or re-key collision.
4. Compare jitter metrics between Primary Underlay (PE-01) vs Secondary Underlay (PE-02).
remediation_actions: Dynamic path steering: Shift latency-sensitive voice/video traffic (EF class) to secondary Hub tunnel.
Enable FEC (Forward Error Correction) and Packet Duplication on degraded tunnel.
Rate-limit bulk file transfers (Scavenger / Best Effort class) via QoS shaping.
blast_radius_impact: Site-level user experience degradation for voice/video calls.

title: Interface Buffer Discards and Tail Drops on Core Backbone
triage_steps: 1. Identify congested interface (e.g. HundredGigE or FourHundredGigE core trunks).
2. Collect IPFIX flow export at 1-second sample rate to detect single large UDP streams.
3. Review WRED (Weighted Random Early Detection) drops vs Tail drops.
remediation_actions: Apply CoS Queue weight adjustment for low-latency queues.
Initiate MPLS Traffic Engineering (MPLS-TE) tunnel diversion to alternate P-Core router.
Apply policer on ingress CE rate-limiting non-critical backup replication.
blast_radius_impact: Regional or Inter-Hub latency amplification affecting all overlay tunnels traversing the core.

title: Datacenter Interconnect (DCI) Heartbeat Asymmetry
trigger_symptoms: Split-brain risk in DC Active-Active CEs
triage_steps: 1. Check TenGigabitEthernet0/1/0 cross-connect status on DC1-CE-01 and DC1-CE-02.
2. Verify BGP EVPN MAC/IP route synchronization between dual DC CEs.
3. Test bidirectional OAM ping over DCI link.
remediation_actions: Force active state on DC1-CE-01 to prevent flapping split-brain.
Reroute DC inter-device sync via management out-of-band network.
Dispatch DC local on-call engineer to replace transceiver.
blast_radius_impact: Critical: May trigger dual-active routing loop if not stabilized.
